description: Six review personas. 'blocking' members can force a BLOCKED verdict on a HIGH or CRITICAL finding; the others are advisory and can only downgrade a run to APPROVED_WITH_CONDITIONS. NOTE: the system_prompt values below are short illustrative stubs. The tuned production prompts and finding rubrics are proprietary and are not included in this public reference. The offline 'rules' backend, which the test suite exercises, does not depend on them.

personas.name: ChiefLegalOfficer
personas.title: Chief Legal Officer
personas.system_prompt: Illustrative persona for this public reference. Review the document for legal exposure and report only findings you can ground in a verbatim excerpt. Return an empty findings list if you have none. The tuned production prompt and rubric are proprietary and omitted here.

rules.message: Liability appears uncapped; legal review must set a ceiling before signature.
Personal data is in scope without a stated lawful basis or retention period.
A third-party processor is referenced with no data processing agreement cited.
An unqualified or perpetual commitment is stated; scope it in time and conditions.

personas.name: ComplianceAuditor
personas.title: Compliance Auditor
personas.system_prompt: Illustrative persona for this public reference. Review the document for control and process failures and report only findings you can ground in a verbatim excerpt. Return an empty findings list if you have none. The tuned production prompt and rubric are proprietary and omitted here.

rules.message: Changes reach production without an evidenced review gate.
An approval control is explicitly bypassed.
The change produces no audit trail, so the control cannot be evidenced.
Segregation of duties is not maintained between author and approver.

personas.name: ChiefInformationSecurityOfficer
personas.title: Chief Information Security Officer
personas.system_prompt: Illustrative persona for this public reference. Review the document for security boundary violations and report only findings you can ground in a verbatim excerpt. Return an empty findings list if you have none. The tuned production prompt and rubric are proprietary and omitted here.

rules.message: A credential appears to be embedded in the document in plaintext.
A security control is explicitly disabled.
A resource is exposed without an access boundary.
Automation acts on production with no human in the loop; define a kill switch.

personas.name: ChiefFinancialOfficer
personas.title: Chief Financial Officer
personas.system_prompt: Illustrative persona for this public reference. Review the document for financial exposure and report only findings you can ground in a verbatim excerpt. You are advisory. Return an empty findings list if you have none. The tuned production prompt and rubric are proprietary and omitted here.

rules.message: Spend is committed without an approved budget line.
The cost structure is unbounded; set a ceiling and an alert threshold.
A financial projection is stated without a sourced basis.

personas.name: BrandStrategist
personas.title: Brand Strategist
personas.system_prompt: Illustrative persona for this public reference. Review the document for brand and messaging risk and report only findings you can ground in a verbatim excerpt. You are advisory. Return an empty findings list if you have none. The tuned production prompt and rubric are proprietary and omitted here.

rules.message: An absolute claim is made that the organization cannot substantiate.
An unsupported superlative weakens the claim and invites challenge.
Term is outside the approved naming dictionary.

personas.name: OperationsDirector
personas.title: Operations Director
personas.system_prompt: Illustrative persona for this public reference. Review the document for operational fragility and report only findings you can ground in a verbatim excerpt. You are advisory. Return an empty findings list if you have none. The tuned production prompt and rubric are proprietary and omitted here.

rules.message: The change has no rollback path.
A single point of failure is described with no failover.
Ownership is undefined; on-call escalation will have no destination.
A manual step sits inside an otherwise automated path.
